title: Cheesy Fettuccine with a Creamy Bisque Sauce
description: A rich and creamy Italian pasta dish featuring a flavorful bisque sauce and melted cheese.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the fettuccine according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the bisque to the skillet and stir to combine with the garlic and butter. Bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and stir in the cream. Let the sauce simmer for 2-3 minutes until slightly thickened.
Stir in the shredded cheese until melted and smooth.
Season the sauce with salt and black pepper to taste.
Drain the cooked fettuccine and add it to the skillet with the bisque sauce. Toss to combine.
Serve the cheesy fettuccine hot, garnished with additional cheese if desired.
Optional: Add some showy parmesan cheese on top for extra flavor and texture.
